## Datasets
- [Fatal Encounters](https://fatalencounters.org/spreadsheets/)
- [Mapping Police Violence](https://mappingpoliceviolence.us/)
- [California Open Justice (open datasets)](https://openjustice.doj.ca.gov/data)
- [Washington Post Police Shootings Dataset](https://www.washingtonpost.com/graphics/investigations/police-shootings-database/)
- [U of Chicago's Crime lab](https://crimelab.uchicago.edu/)
- [U Miss Library Guide for Crime Statistics](https://libraryguides.missouri.edu/c.php?g=165704&p=1088070)
- [FBI Crime Data Explorer](https://cde.ucr.cjis.gov/LATEST/webapp/#/pages/home)
- [Vera Institute's Incarceration Trends](https://github.com/vera-institute/incarceration-trends)
- [Prison Map - Geography of Incarceration](https://prisonmap.com/)
- [Correctional Procurement Contracts](https://www.prisonpolicy.org/contracts/documents.html)
- [North Carolina Department of Public Instruction](https://www.dpi.nc.gov/data-reports/common-education-data-analysis-and-reporting-system-cedars)
- [CMPD Incidents](https://data.charlottenc.gov/datasets/d22200cd879248fcb2258e6840bd6726_0/explore?location=35.227619%2C-80.841935%2C12)
- [Charlotte Mecklenburg Quality of Life Explorer](https://maps.mecklenburgcountync.gov/qol/#89/)
- [U.S. Census Bureau - American Community Survey (ACS)](https://www.census.gov/programs-surveys/acs)
- [Student Boundary Maps](https://www.cmsk12.org/academics/planning-services/student-boundary-maps)

## Data Collections
These have more tha one dataset, but are not massive clearinghouses
- [Across Walls](https://www.acrosswalls.org/) *This site can be a little difficult to navigate, but they have a lot of specific data not generally available elsewhere, like this [final statements, last meals](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/u/1/d/1RF-0BkAVaWwWTlQdkswsfQFmq1x1N4xWL6cHAytuydE/pubhtml) dataset.
- [and other repos by the Vera Institute](https://github.com/vera-institute)


## Data Clearinghouses 
- [ICPSR](https://www.icpsr.umich.edu/sites/icpsr/find-data)
- [Data.gov](https://catalog.data.gov)
